Title: Correct way to document RedirectResponse in openapi?
Description: **Description**

How can I make openapi work correctly if i my handler return a RedirectResponse?

I try simply do this but i got ValidationError

```python

from starlette.responses import RedirectResponse, Response
app = FastAPI(docs_url="/")


@app.get('/redirect', status_code=307, response_class=Response)
async def redirect():
    return RedirectResponse('/')
# OR
@router.get('/redirect', response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def redirect():
    return RedirectResponse('/')

if __name__ == '__main__':

    uvicorn.run(app, port=8001, reload=True)
```
